messages:
Ava (Design): quick UX poke — the new invoke preview panel in the playground is great visually but I hit two accessibility/flow issues when trying keyboard-first flows. focus seems trapped on the close button and you can’t arrow into the tools list.
Mateo (DevEx): can you repro steps? iirc we used a modal pattern to avoid background clicks while editing function defs.
Ava (Design): repro: open a function, click \'preview invocation\', press Tab — focus jumps to Close, then back to the top of the panel. expected: roving focus into the tool items and the first interactive element in body.
Priya (Frontend): thanks — that sounds like our dialog autotrapping via focus-lock. we can adjust to allow focusable children inside the panel body. quick patch idea: make tool list a roving tabindex list and set dialog initial focus to the list instead of the close button.
Raj (Accessibility): roving tabindex + aria-activedescendant is fine. also add aria-labels and role=listbox on the tool list. example:
messages_continued:
```html
  • Summarize
  • Call API
``` Raj (Accessibility): also ensure escape key closes, trap is waived when focus moves into list, and provide `aria-describedby` pointing to short keyboard hint. Sam (PM): small product note — we need to keep the preview lightweight. if we change focus target to the list, make sure mobile keyboard opening doesn't obscure the panel body. Priya (Frontend): good call. mobile-wise we should default to a bottom sheet on small widths; desktop gets the side panel with roving focus. Mateo (DevEx): implementation plan: 1) swap initial focus to tool-list (small PR) 2) add aria attrs & roving tabindex (Priya) 3) QA keyboard pass (QA-Bot) 4) add small tooltip copy tweak for the preview header. QA-Bot: flagged: keyboard-only navigation testcases added to playground e2e list. test ids: PLG-KEY-37, PLG-KEY-38. Ava (Design): copy tweak suggestion for the header: change "Preview invocation" -> "Invocation preview (keyboard: Tab / ↑↓ to navigate)"? maybe too verbose. open to shorter hint. Sam (PM): prefer shorter. maybe: "Invocation preview — use Tab or Arrow keys" and the hint is visually hidden but on hover shows a tiny helper. Raj (Accessibility): visually-hidden helper is fine but include visible hint icon with aria-describedby for sighted keyboard users. screen readers should still get the full instruction via sr-only text. Priya (Frontend): i can add an icon button with aria-expanded mapping for the helper, and a small CSS .sr-only block with the full instruction. Mateo (DevEx): tempo PR: matthew/devex/invoke-preview-focus-2301 — will open by EOD. can reviewers include @Priya and @Raj. Ava (Design): thanks — also tiny UI nit: the run-history row preview truncation cuts the function name mid-word. can we prefer word-break: break-word or show ellipsis at boundary? it reads weird. Priya (Frontend): will default to ellipsis with tooltip on hover and full name in compact detail panel. Sam (PM): prioritize keyboard + SR fixes in patch, run-history truncation can be follow-up if needed. Ava (Design): okay — if the first PR includes the aria + focus fix and the hidden helper copy, we can ship behind a feature flag and test with a11y lab. :thumbsup: Mateo (DevEx): noted. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/482 — assign reviewers. Raj (Accessibility): will review tomorrow AM. quick checklist to include in PR description: focus order, aria roles, escape behavior, screen reader announcement of panel open. Priya (Frontend): will add unit + storybook knobs for keyboard interactions. QA-Bot: regression run scheduled. results will be posted in #devex in ~2 hours. Ava (Design): thanks team — feels good to close this small UX loop. please ping me if copy needs micro-tuning. :sparkles:
